description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with a backend API in a Next.js project. It includes functions to resolve the API base URL from environment variables and to fetch collections from the backend API, with error handling.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Resolves the backend API base URL from environment variables and normalizes it by removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: fetchCollection(collectionName)
methods.description: Fetches a specified collection from the backend API, constructing the URL based on the base URL and collection name, with error handling for missing configuration and failed requests.
